caption: The worked example's page as one tree: body has five sibling regions in source order — header, nav, main, aside, footer — while main holds the one article and the article holds the video with its two sources and one caption track. Because aside is a sibling of main, CSS can move it beside the story and the reading order stays the same.

spec.aria: Tree of the page: body has five child regions header, nav, main, aside and footer; main contains one article with an h2 and two paragraphs, and the article contains a video with two sources and one caption track.
